**FINDING (C4 MAJOR-1) RESOLVED: created_at re-stamp ACCEPTED by C0 doctrine; upstream fix filed as engram#589**

What: C4 review MAJOR-1 — records-only pull re-stamps created_at (engram save has no timestamp flag → hydrated observations get wall-clock insert time; importRecord computes created_at from record.ts but the verb discards it).

RESOLUTION (human ruling at CP-C4): ACCEPTED by C0 doctrine — engram = regenerable cache; ts in records/ = temporal truth (source of truth); created_at in the engine = engine metadata. NOT data loss; idempotency unaffected (topic_key upsert). The fix is UPSTREAM, precedent = ADR-0002 --dir.

Status: DONE on the brain side (disclosed in code at _defaultEngramSave, engram.mjs; MINOR-1 fixed — --scope now passed). Upstream feature request FILED: **Gentleman-Programming/engram#589** — "preserve original timestamp on ingest (--created-at flag or bulk records-import verb)". Follow-up tracked there; a bulk records-import verb would also speed the ~275-record rebuild and should preserve the topic_key idempotency guarantee.

Where: brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs (_defaultEngramSave + importMemory), engram-import.mjs:71. Related: [[sdd/issue-229-c4/done]]. Upstream: engram#589.
